attempted_claim: Let X be n x n complex iid centred entries with variance 1/n, bounded density, finite 4+eps moments matching Ginibre to third order. Let rho_n^{(k)}, rho_Gin^{(k)} be the k-point functions and E_n={z: ||z|-1| <= A n^{-1/2} log n} the circular soft-edge cell (fixed A). Then for k=1,2 and every fixed smooth f supported in E_n^k, |int f (rho_n^{(k)}-rho_Gin^{(k)})| <= C_f n^{-delta} with explicit delta >= 1/24, proved via non-Hermitian DBM coupling to time t=n^{-1/3} plus a loop-equation local law for the Hermitization resolvent at eta0=n^{-3/4+tau} (fixed small tau).
